SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Classification of Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Classification of Plants.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Classification of Plants.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Classification of Plants.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Classification of Plants.

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking 14 3.2. Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking 14 3.2. Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking 14 3.2. Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking 14 3.2. Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking 14 3.2. Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number .

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sound Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sound Energy.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sound Energy.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Sound Energy.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sound Energy.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution .

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Pollution.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Pollution.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Pollution.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Pollution.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Water Pollution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
